tagline: A passion project: one warm family screen with 15+ small apps, from photos and calendar to radio and household bills.

listing.detail: A personal passion project: one family screen with 15+ small apps: clock, weather, photo frame, shared calendar, local events, messages, chores, recipes, shopping lists, Bulgarian radio and TV, nursery songs, stocks and household bills. Built grandma-friendly for wall displays. Almost ready for others to try.
listing.audience: Families who like the idea of one shared screen at home, across generations and across households, and are happy to try something early.
talkingPoints: A personal passion project, built for a real family's wall screen.
More than 15 small apps on one screen: clock, weather, photo frame, calendar, messages, chores, recipes, shopping lists and more.
Grandma-friendly design: large type and a simple layout for every generation.
Connected households can see each other's local weather.
Almost ready for others to try; early testers are welcome.
listing.callToAction: Take a look at Family Frame; early testers are welcome.
avoidClaims: Family Frame is a finished commercial product or SaaS with support or an SLA. It is a personal passion project, still being tested.
Family Frame has a paid tier or subscription.
Family Frame is a hardware device. It is a web app (PWA) for screens you already own.
Family Frame is made or endorsed by Google, Clerk or Replit.
